parsed.explanation: High Risk. Active traveler-facing controls make discovery consequential: national rules make documents and visa/entry screening sex-binary, permit refusal/extra evidence checks, and travelers report passport/visa blockage/stranding. Facility bans across many jurisdictions create universal bathroom exposure; four states criminalize it and a documented arrest plus male-ward detention shows enforcement. Custody and immigration-detention policies raise severe harm: misgendered placement, hormone denial, and reported forced labour/sexual abuse. Partial federal/state protections and litigation exist, but institutions are enforcing hostile rules, so rule-of-law mitigates little. No execution or trans-specific campaign is documented, yet probability and severity after outing are high.
